attachments.title: Required Attachments
attachments.req2: Three (3) security clearance forms + parent's ID copy or death certificate (if applicable). Must be submitted at least two months before the conference date.
attachments.req4: Evidence of paper acceptance from the conference organizers (if any).

knowledgeBase.title: Important Guidelines Before Submission:
knowledgeBase.general1: All uploaded documents must be in clear PDF format.
knowledgeBase.general2: Submit your request at least two months before the conference date.
knowledgeBase.presenterOnly: As a presenter: You must attach the official acceptance letter from the organizers.
knowledgeBase.listenerOnly: As a listener: Your request is limited to attending scientific events only.
